text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio, so close to the Triple Crown, suffers a broken bone shortly before summer break. The media predicts her chances of competing in the Kikuka Sho to be extremely slim.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A full recovery would take six months, but Teio's already started physical therapy, and declares she'll be back on her feet in time for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way she can make it. But that's reason enough for her to find a way. She always knew she was in for an uphill struggle, so she won't let this setback stop her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp finally arrives. With a sunny expression on her face, Yamanin Zephyr announces that she's going to run full speed towards her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The path ahead of her will be treacherous, but Teio has inspired her to stay positive, and now, we're both ready for summer.
